transcript.text: Hi! I'm Ava, an AI recruiting assistant for Harbor Logistics. I'm calling about your application for the Warehouse Operator role. This call takes about five minutes, your answers are saved for our recruiting team, and a person on the team makes every decision. Could you please tell me your name, and do you agree to continue with this screening call?
Hi Ava! Yes, my name is Marta Diaz, and I'm happy to go ahead with this call. Before we start, could you tell me how much this position pays?

sentiment.reason: The candidate is polite and asks about the pay calmly.

transcript.text:
The pay is 1,580 euros gross per month, in 14 payments a year, and Saturday shifts in peak season are paid at 1.5 times the normal rate. 

To start, Marta, do you have a valid permit to work in Spain?
That sounds great, thank you for the information. Yes, I do have a valid permit to work in Spain.

sentiment.reason: The candidate is polite and answers the question positively.

transcript.text: Great, thanks. This job has rotating morning and afternoon shifts, Monday to Friday. Which shifts are you able to work?
I can work both morning and afternoon shifts, no problem. I was actually wondering, are there any night shifts available as well?

sentiment.reason: The candidate is positive and asks a polite question.

transcript.text:
There are no night shifts for this role; the shifts rotate weekly between morning (6:00 to 14:00) and afternoon (14:00 to 22:00), Monday to Friday.

When would you be able to start working with us?
I can start immediately, as I don't have any notice period at the moment. I'm fully available and ready to go!

sentiment.reason: The candidate is positive, enthusiastic, and ready to start immediately.

transcript.text: That's perfect, Marta! This job is located at the Getafe logistics park in Madrid. Can you get there reliably, even for the 6:00 AM morning shift?
Yes, I can get there very reliably. I have my own transport, so commuting to the Getafe logistics park for the 6:00 AM shift won't be a problem at all.

sentiment.reason: The candidate is positive and confirms reliable transport easily.

transcript.text: That's great to hear. Now, I'd love to hear a bit about your experience. Could you tell me about a time when you had to finish some work with a team under tight time pressure? What did you do?

Last Christmas at the supermarket where I worked, two delivery trucks arrived really late right before opening. I quickly split our team into pairs so we could work more efficiently, and we managed to unload everything just in time.

sentiment.reason: The candidate provides a calm, detailed answer to the question.

transcript.text:
That sounds like a busy day, but you handled it really well! 

Could you also tell me about a time you noticed a safety risk or a mistake at work, and what you did about it?

Once, I noticed a heavy pallet leaning dangerously near one of the emergency exits. I immediately stopped work in that area and reported it to my supervisor, and we got it safely restacked right away.

sentiment.reason: The candidate calmly and clearly answers the interview question.

transcript.text:
Thank you, Marta, that was a great example of putting safety first. 

I'd like to invite you to a video interview with our warehouse manager. Would any of these times work for you?
- Wednesday, November 11th at 4:00 PM
- Thursday, November 12th at 12:30 PM
- Friday, November 13th at 10:00 AM
Before we book that, I have one quick question: am I allowed to bring my dog to work with me? If that's okay, I would like to choose the last option, Friday, November 13th at 10:00 AM.

sentiment.reason: The candidate asks a calm question and selects an interview time.

transcript.text: I don't have that detail about bringing dogs to work, but the manager can definitely answer that during your interview. Shall we go ahead and book Friday, November 13th at 10:00 AM?
Yes, please, let's go ahead and book Friday, November 13th at 10:00 AM. I can ask the manager about my dog then, thank you!

sentiment.reason: The candidate is agreeable, polite, and completely satisfied.

transcript.text: Perfect. Your video interview with the warehouse manager is booked for Friday 13 November at 10:00. Your reference is INT-129051. You will get the details by email. Thank you for your time, and good luck!
